Visual revision 3 — artist-made anatomy:
Blender Human Base Meshes bundle v1.2.0, realistic male body and realistic hand.
Blender Studio / contributing artists (male body asset: Dan Ulrich).
CC0 1.0 Universal.
Source: https://download.blender.org/demo/asset-bundles/human-base-meshes/human-base-meshes-bundle-v1.2.0.zip
Converted to indexed mesh buffers; adapted to the existing game skeleton.
Roman clothing, armor, statue drapery, banners and new architectural details are project-created.
The supplied combined reference is retained in art-source/reference.png for visual comparison only.
